# Wookieepedia fixtures

The opening of each article, up to its first section heading, as it appears in Fandom's
Wookieepedia dump (`starwars_pages_current.xml.7z`, published 2026-08-01). The parser in
`src/ingest/wookieepedia/` reads exactly this part of an article.

**License:** the text is from [Wookieepedia](https://starwars.fandom.com) and is licensed under
[CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Each file is an excerpt of the
article named by the file. Excerpts were cut at the first heading and are otherwise unchanged.
Don't edit them. To refresh them, extract the same pages from a newer dump.
